name: Jacob (Joseph's father)
title: Joseph's father in Jesus' genealogy
summary: Jacob was the son of Matthan and the father of Joseph, Mary's husband, according to Matthew's genealogy. He was the last link before Joseph in Jesus' earthly lineage.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesus' genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jacob is listed in Matthew's genealogy as the father of Joseph, Mary's husband.
